title: Download logs for a diagnostic signature

abstract.text: Get the anonymized backtrace logs associated with a specific diagnostic signature.
The resource ID that uniquely identifies a diagnostic signature. Obtain the diagnostic signature resource ID from the `GET-v1-builds-_id_-diagnosticSignatures` response.
The maximum number of diagnostic logs to return.
An error occurred with your request.

paragraphs.text: The example below requests a single disk write diagnostic log for a specific signature.

**Request**

```
GET https://api.appstoreconnect.apple.com/v1/diagnosticSignatures/012a219872fe2aa3ca056df08dc9161007a26879a1c1475ca2e2712f7d0aefd7b4/logs?limit=1
```
